meta.title: CMIP6 GCM sea-level pressure (psl) reproducibility over the Northwest Pacific
meta.data_status: PROVISIONAL: values transcribed from the analysis figures and printed outputs. Per-statistic NRMSE has 2 decimals; mean/ext NRMSE 3 decimals. Entire: corr and sd_ratio for all 21 models (Taylor diagram; printed values for 8 models, others digitized from the figure, see metrics[...][...][model].taylor_source), sd_mod and crmse derived from them. Other periods: corr/bias/sd_ratio/rmse for 8 models only (others null). bias/rmse: 8 models only. No spatial fields. Regenerate with p8_viewer_data.py from the original results to replace this file.

region.common_grid: 19 (lon) × 26 (lat) = 494 points, bilinear interpolation of native-grid statistics

metrics.nrmse: RMSE / spatial SD of ERA5 (lower is better)

ranking.ext: rank of the arithmetic mean of p5, p1, min NRMSE
ranking.order: ascending NRMSE (1 = best); ties share the lowest rank

meta.qc: GCM days with domain-mean psl < 985 hPa or > 1035 hPa removed (AWI-ESM-1-REcoM: 36 days, none in JJA)
meta.model_selection: models with psl, uas, vas for historical, SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP5-8.5 (20) + IPSL-CM6A-LR
notes: NRMSE denominators differ between periods; compare RMSE or correlation across periods.
min is a single-day value and is dominated by tropical cyclones in summer; interpret with care.
